services.title: Comprehensive Broadcast
services.description: From signal origination to last-mile delivery, we provide every service your channel needs to stay on air and reach audiences across India.

items.title: Live Streaming Services
items.description: End-to-end live streaming with ultra-low latency delivery. We manage encoding, packaging, and CDN distribution so your content reaches viewers flawlessly across devices.

items.title: EPG Management
items.description: Accurate Electronic Program Guide creation and maintenance across all major platforms. Schedule management, metadata optimization, and real-time EPG updates 24/7.

items.title: SCTE-35 / SCTE-53 Services
items.description: Professional ad-insertion signalling with SCTE-35 markers and highlight-based SCTE-53 services. Frame-accurate cue generation for seamless ad replacement.

items.title: Playout Solutions
items.description: Reliable on-premise and cloud-based playout systems with automated scheduling, failover redundancy, and multi-format output for broadcast-grade content delivery.

items.title: Cloud Playout
items.description: Scalable cloud-native playout infrastructure that eliminates capex. Spin up new channels in minutes with full automation, disaster recovery, and geo-redundant delivery.

items.title: CueStream SCTE-35 Encoder
items.description: Our proprietary CueStream encoder delivers frame-accurate SCTE-35 cue insertion with intuitive workflow management, supporting live and file-based operations.
